title: US man on the ‘worst part’ of living in India: ‘It's so cheap'
summary_full: A Seattle creator's video sarcastically lists India's worst aspects, which are actually its strengths. Affordable and high-quality healthcare is a significant advantage for residents. Rapid e-commerce delivery services provide convenience for daily needs. Strong community ties and neighborly relationships are a notable aspect of Indian life. The video sparked diverse reactions, with many agreeing and some disagreeing with his points.
